content:
I'm very excited to announce the arrival of the v4.8.0 release of Lean!

There's a huge list of improvements, which you can read about in

  • the blog post or
  • the release notes.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.8.0.

Batteries, Aesop, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.8.0, as well as lean4checker and lean-repl.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.8.0
  • there is a v4.8.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
Just a small thing but the link in the intro of the blog post to the relnotes points to rc2 btw
